label: flash-vague-final-consistency-20261005-10
scope: Independent counterexamples in completed intermediate design only. Integration/review may repair these. This is not a final content verdict and does not edit any planning state.

findings.finding: importBackup and batchImportNotes do not carry a preview revision/generation token; overwrite pseudocode clears before checking the displayed preview baseline. A competing edit after preview is not rejected by the written contract.

BackupPayload promises full metadata round-trip, but overwrite pseudocode resets backupTracker to now/zero and never writes verified appMeta. Preservation or deliberate replacement of backup tracker/settings lacks one explicit shared policy.
Strong validation is named but the required rules for all Note fields, revision/generation integers, cross-field trash metadata, tag relationships and meta duplication remain unspecified.
